description: BCM API contract for updating a Kubernetes cluster

request_notes.args[0]: FULL KubeCluster entity including uuid (PUT semantics)
request_notes.semantics: Requires complete entity, cannot send partial updates (PATCH)

response_notes.return_value: Success boolean, does not return full entity
response_notes.timing: Returns in 2-5 seconds, actual update may be asynchronous
response_notes.read_after: Call getKubeCluster after update to get new state

response_error_conflict.error: Revision conflict - cluster has been modified by another process

steps: 2. Build cluster entity with UUID from state using buildClusterEntity()
5. Call readCluster() to fetch updated state from BCM
important_notes: Entity must include ALL fields, not just changed ones
UUID comes from state, other values from plan
Must read back after update to get computed fields
